title: Not a wrapper
angle: Ten API capabilities, each one followed by our code that can throw its answer away. Codex as the fifth teammate. The only pitch where you talk over a diagram for 90 seconds.

slides.title: Every lane has the same shape
slides.caption: Schema for shape, allowlist for truth: the API does the part only a model can do, our code decides whether it is allowed out.
notes: *Ninety seconds on this one slide.* Rehearse the pointing: orange is an OpenAI call, cream is our code, and the two black boxes are the man and the page.

"Nine OpenAI capabilities carry this product, all through one file. And behind every one of them, code that can throw the answer away. *The model never gets to be the answer — it only gets to point.*"

~Schema for shape, allowlist for truth.~ Structured Outputs fixes the shape; the grounding gate decides whether it is allowed out — a quote not found in the PDF text layer is dropped, an id that was not in the candidate list is dropped, and the SERVER, not the model, slices every citation.

The model decides exactly three things: which vehicle is in the photo, which page ids answer this sentence, and how to phrase what those pages already print. Everything else on this line is deterministic — BM25 in process, no embeddings, no vector database.

85% of asks never reach the picker at all: BM25 was decisive, or it was a spec question answered off parsed rows with zero LLM calls. Ingest is a different clock — $0.095 once per manual, then every question on it forever is four hundredths of a cent.

slides.text: It mocked out BM25 scoring and wrote a test that pinned where the confidence floor sat in the pipeline: on the raw BM25 peak, before the keyword and title bonuses were applied.
notes: Say the verbatim paragraph from openai.md §3. The diagnosis in one read: ~torque~ is printed in almost every section, so its IDF collapses, the peak never reaches the floor of 1.2, and the exact keyword hit on ~tightening torque~ never got to vote. Gate changed to `peak < FLOOR and not evidence`. All ten bare rider queries now rank their printed section first.

*Then be honest about the cost of the teammate.* In run 2 it silently swapped the ten queries the prompt named for eight easier ones and reported success — the prompt had forbidden that. ~Codex found the bug only because the prompt told it not to hide one, and it still tried to. Read the diff, always.~

Run 3 audited the arithmetic behind every number on these slides: 65 tests, green first try, not a line of app/llm.py touched. Three of the sixteen test modules in api/tests are Codex's — 194 of the 617 passing tests.

groups.label: All nine, global
items: ElevenLabs voice is never "live" — "built, one key away". The live voice is Deepgram, deepgram: true.
The 3D backdrop is a technical grid. No panorama, no photographic workshop scene.
Dropbox folder sync and Climate Fit are "built, deploying", not deployed.
Never quote a running ledger total without the date beside it. Prefer not quoting it.
Never call 13,537 "manuals" — distinct fetchable PDFs is 14,770.
Never call 4,081 and 1,489 the same number.
There is no checkout. "Live prices", never "buy".
